tests.name: Test 1
tests.description: Blue pintuck tablecloth + Ghost chiavari chairs → Green/gold chargers + Rose gold cutlery → Blue/white dinner plates + Rose gold napkins → Champagne flutes + Green centerpiece

operations.name: Blue Pintuck Tablecloth
operations.prompt: Change the tablecloth on the table to a royal blue pintuck tablecloth matching the reference. Keep the gold chiavari chairs with white cushions. 8 chairs around the round table.
operations.notes: User must change chairs first or click same chair to see result

operations.name: Ghost Chiavari Chairs
operations.prompt: Replace all 8 chairs with clear acrylic ghost chiavari chairs with white cushions matching the reference. Keep the blue pintuck tablecloth on the round table.

operations.name: Green & Gold Charger Plates
operations.prompt: Add 8 green and gold baroque charger plates at each place setting on the blue pintuck tablecloth, matching the reference. One at each seat position. Ghost chiavari chairs around the table.

operations.name: Rose Gold Cutlery
operations.prompt: Add rose gold cutlery at each place setting beside the charger plates. 2 forks on left, knife and spoon on right of each plate. Matching the reference.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 2)
operations.prompt: Remove the table from this image. Leave the charger plates and cutlery floating in the air. Do not change anything about the products (size or orientation).

operations.name: Fusion A (Set 1 + Set 2.5)
operations.prompt: Place the floating green/gold charger plates with rose gold cutlery onto the blue pintuck tablecloth table with ghost chiavari chairs. Align 8 place settings evenly around the table.

operations.name: Blue & White Dinner Plates
operations.prompt: Add 8 blue and white vintage floral dinner plates on top of each charger plate, matching the reference. Keep the cutlery on the sides.

operations.name: Rose Gold Napkins
operations.prompt: Add rose gold satin napkins folded elegantly on top of each dinner plate, matching the reference. Keep all other elements.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 3)
operations.prompt: Remove the table from this image. Leave the dinner plates and napkins floating in the air.

operations.name: Fusion B (Image A + Set 3.5)
operations.prompt: Layer the floating dinner plates and napkins on top of the charger plates on the table. Stack: charger plate → dinner plate → napkin.

operations.name: Green Crystal Centerpiece
operations.prompt: Add a green cut crystal vase centerpiece to the exact center of the table, matching the reference. Keep all place settings.

operations.name: Champagne Flutes
operations.prompt: Add 8 champagne flutes at each place setting, positioned above and to the right of the knife. Crystal clear glass.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 4)
operations.prompt: Remove the table from this image. Leave the centerpiece and champagne flutes floating.

operations.name: Fusion C (Image B + Set 4.5) - FINAL
operations.prompt: Place the floating green centerpiece in the center of the table and champagne flutes at each place setting.

tests.name: Test 2
tests.description: Gold chiavari chairs + Gold chargers/cutlery → Red dinner plates + Pink napkins → Pink/gold centerpiece + Wine glasses

operations.name: Gold Charger Plates
operations.prompt: Add 8 elegant gold charger plates at each place setting on the white tablecloth. One at each seat position around the round table. Gold chiavari chairs with white cushions.

operations.name: Gold Cutlery
operations.prompt: Add gold cutlery at each place setting. Fork on left, knife and spoon on right of each charger plate.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 2)
operations.prompt: Remove the table from this image. Leave the gold charger plates and cutlery floating.

operations.name: Fusion A (Set 1 + Set 2.5)
operations.prompt: Place the floating gold charger plates and cutlery onto the white tablecloth table with gold chiavari chairs.

operations.name: Red Dinner Plates
operations.prompt: Add 8 red dinner plates on top of each gold charger plate.

operations.name: Pink Napkins
operations.prompt: Add pink satin napkins folded elegantly on top of each red dinner plate.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 3)
operations.prompt: Remove the table. Leave the red dinner plates and pink napkins floating.

operations.name: Fusion B (Image A + Set 3.5)
operations.prompt: Layer the floating red dinner plates and pink napkins on top of the gold charger plates.

operations.name: Pink & Gold Centerpiece
operations.prompt: Add a pink rose ball centerpiece on an elegant gold stand to the center of the table.

operations.name: Wine Glasses
operations.prompt: Add 8 crystal wine glasses at each place setting, positioned above the knife.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 4)
operations.prompt: Remove the table. Leave the centerpiece and wine glasses floating.

operations.name: Fusion C (Image B + Set 4.5) - FINAL
operations.prompt: Place the floating pink/gold centerpiece in center and wine glasses at each setting.

tests.name: Test 3
tests.description: Full 8-set workflow: Champagne pintuck + Ghost phoenix → Purple chargers → Black cutlery → White plates → Champagne napkins → Purple/black centerpiece → Wine glasses

operations.name: Champagne Pintuck Tablecloth
operations.prompt: Change the tablecloth to a champagne/gold pintuck tablecloth matching the reference. Keep the gold chiavari chairs.

operations.name: Ghost Phoenix Chairs
operations.prompt: Replace all 8 chairs with clear acrylic ghost phoenix chairs with oval backs, matching the reference. Keep the champagne pintuck tablecloth.

operations.name: Gold Charger Plates (Base)
operations.prompt: Add 8 gold charger plates at each place setting on the champagne pintuck tablecloth.

operations.name: Purple Reef Charger Plates
operations.prompt: Change the charger plates to purple reef acrylic charger plates with textured edges, matching the reference.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 3)
operations.prompt: Remove the table. Leave the purple charger plates floating in position.

operations.name: Fused Image A (Set 2 + Set 3.5)
operations.prompt: Place the floating purple charger plates onto the champagne pintuck table with ghost phoenix chairs. 8 place settings evenly spaced.

operations.name: Gold Cutlery (Base)
operations.prompt: Add gold cutlery beside each purple charger plate. Fork on left, knife and spoon on right.

operations.name: Black Matte Cutlery
operations.prompt: Change the cutlery to matte black modern cutlery matching the reference.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 4)
operations.prompt: Remove the table. Leave the black cutlery floating.

operations.name: Fused Image B (Fused A + Set 4.5)
operations.prompt: Place the floating black cutlery beside each purple charger plate on the table.

operations.name: Red Dinner Plates (Base)
operations.prompt: Add red dinner plates on top of each purple charger plate.

operations.name: White Dinner Plates
operations.prompt: Change the dinner plates to simple white dinner plates matching the reference.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 5)
operations.prompt: Remove the table. Leave the white dinner plates floating.

operations.name: Fused Image C (Fused B + Set 5.5)
operations.prompt: Layer the floating white dinner plates on top of the purple charger plates.

operations.name: Pink Napkins (Base)
operations.prompt: Add pink folded napkins on top of each white dinner plate.

operations.name: Champagne Napkins
operations.prompt: Change the napkins to champagne/gold shantung napkins matching the reference.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 6)
operations.prompt: Remove the table. Leave the champagne napkins floating.

operations.name: Fused Image D (Fused C + Set 6.5)
operations.prompt: Place the floating champagne napkins on top of the white dinner plates.

operations.name: Pink & Gold Centerpiece (Base)
operations.prompt: Add a pink rose ball centerpiece on a gold stand to the center of the table.

operations.name: Purple & Black Feather Centerpiece
operations.prompt: Change the centerpiece to a tall purple and black ostrich feather arrangement on a black stand, matching the reference.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 7)
operations.prompt: Remove the table. Leave the purple/black centerpiece floating.

operations.name: Fused Image E (Fused D + Set 7.5)
operations.prompt: Place the floating purple/black feather centerpiece in the center of the table.

operations.name: Wine Glasses
operations.prompt: Add crystal wine glasses at each place setting, positioned above the knife.

operations.name: Table Removal (Set 8)
operations.prompt: Remove the table. Leave the wine glasses floating.

operations.name: Fused Image F (Fused E + Set 8.5) - FINAL
operations.prompt: Place the floating wine glasses at each place setting on the complete table setup.
